title: Exchange-only qubit stabilized by a single-spin qubit
summary: Hybrid approaches that combine different spin qubit encodings offer promising advantages. In particular, the additional degrees of freedom available in exchange-only qubits and their extensions enable enhanced spin lifetimes and facilitate error detection through the use of auxiliary spins. We show that integrating Loss-DiVincenzo with exchange-only qubits provides a practical route to realizing these benefits while remaining compatible with spin-shuttling architectures.
